programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu parie sa chère carapace que la nouvelle « plante » poussée dans le potager est une cacahuète. Mais la petite tortue perd son pari. Elle doit donner sa carapace aux belettes. Très vite sa carapace lui manque. Comment la récupérer ?Alors que Lulu veut être le capitaine du bateau qu'ils sont en train de construire, les copains la mettent à l'épreuve pour voir si elle en est capable…

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu et ses amis trouvent un œuf abandonné. Après avoir cherché ses parents sans succès, ils décident de s'en occuper à tour de rôle. Mais lorsque Belotte et Rebelotte doivent le garder, l'œuf disparaît.Chante-Faux, le jeune rossignol, s'entend très bien avec Lulu. Ils deviennent de bons amis ce qui rend Rien-Ne-Sert jaloux. Une dispute éclate entre lui et Lulu. Comment vont-ils se réconcilier ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Dans le ciel, deux nuages ressemblent à Rien-Ne-Sert et Lulu qui courent. Mais qui a gagné ? Frou-Frou organise une vraie course jusqu'à la clairière pour les départager. Pendant ce temps, la maîtresse n'arrive pas en classe. Lulu et Frou-Frou entendent des bruits étranges dans la forêt et partent la chercher.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carmélito, fou amoureux de Coquillette, devient l'inspirateur de Shakespeare et incarne Roméo. Pendant une répétition, Coquillette est capturée par les rats, mais Carmélito la sauve héroïquement. Plus tard, Coquenpâte et Bangcoq, fugueurs enfermés dehors, tombent dans un piège des rats. Heureusement, Carmen, Carmélito, Bélino et Tom Sawyer volent à leur secours !

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Bélino découvre un tapis volant, vite convoité par les rats. Carmen ruse et libère Bélino avec un sac rempli… de poussière ! Plus tard, un loup peureux devient ami avec Bélino. Avec l'aide de La Fontaine, ils l'aident à devenir un vrai loup. Lors d'une attaque de rats, il fait fuir les ennemis grâce à une mise en scène terrifiante. Fini les moqueries, le loup est un héros !

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Grizzli, invincible aux chatouilles, reçoit un courrier qui le fait rire aux éclats. Qui est responsable ? Ara, Babouin ou Gorille ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine prend un jour off, et Sherlock doit enquêter avec le maladroit Kangourou. Olonbec a perdu son stylo en or, volé par un patient avec une tache d'encre : Vieux Cheval, Cigogne ou Cochonne d'Inde ?

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: La Pieuvre, surmenée au resto de Chef Panda, se fait saboter ses tentacules. Qui ? Éléphant, Vampire ou Autruche ? Sherlock prétend ne jamais être surpris, mais Hermine veut lui prouver le contraire. Le Mainate subit un chantage pour récupérer son carnet de blagues. Qui est derrière ? Orang-outan, Gorfou ou Mouffette ? Sherlock s'obsède sur un jeu mystique.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Pour libérer le Baron Funderchen, Marcus doit utiliser des bottes roses pour vaincre les Soldat-Requins. Mais il trouve ça trop « fille » et hésite, surtout quand Ephi et Gratrok se battent pour ces bottes. Ensuite, Marcus doit battre Vipkrad et son patatomon Caninator en entraînant Limoumou, un nouveau patatomon dont le pouvoir reste un mystère.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Des desperados envahissent le saloon et réclament leurs laits fraise. Marcus doit assurer le service malgré leurs provocations. Ensuite, pour sauver le roi des elfes malade, Marcus et ses amis doivent trouver les ingrédients d'une potion. Ils croisent un druide, mais ce dernier s'avère un vrai boulet, compliquant la mission.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon échange sa niche contre le bateau de Bagou, mais regrette vite le confort du campement. Une bouteille avec un message de trésor pirate lance une course entre eux pour le trouver. Grabouillon perd le cahier de vacances de Pétunia, et Kivala l'aide à réviser. Quand Grabouillon casse l'antenne TV, lui et Bagou improvisent un spectacle pour distraire les filles.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon se fait un tatouage au henné et croit avoir des pouvoirs magiques. Intrigués par des fusées, lui et Bagou craignent une attaque extraterrestre. Grabouillon colle son os sur un hévéa et découvre l'élasticité du caoutchouc. Enfin, partis en bateau pneumatique, ils s'échouent sur un îlot perdu dans la brume.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: Je taime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt2
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Mutant Tiger Chronicles
programme.desc: Chine, 560 après J.-C. Un étrange virus infecte des tigres assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: La Nuit du Templier
programme.desc: Le chevalier médiéval Lord Gregoire, trahi par son propre conseiller et ses guerriers pour une abondance d'or et de richesses, jure qu'après que ces traîtres auront profité de dix vies d'excès, il se vengera dans le sang.

programme.title: La Légende des Mondes
programme.desc: Dans une contrée aujourd'hui disparue, les derniers des Hobbits vivent dans un petit village.

programme.title: SOS chasseurs de monstres
programme.desc: Un groupe de pré-adolescents ingénieux lancent après l'école un business d'“extermination” de monstres imaginaires pour débarrasser leurs jeunes voisins des créatures qui se cachent sous leurs lits ou dans leurs penderies.

programme.title: L'Esprit d'Halloween
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un magasin d'Halloween ouvre dans un centre commercial désert, trois amis, pensant avoir grandi, décident d'y passer la nuit enfermés. Mais leur soirée amusante tourne vite en lutte pour survivre face à des événements terrifiants.

programme.title: Foxter & Max
programme.desc: Un pré-adolescent artistique et frustré découvre que le chien graffiti qu'il a peint avec une boîte trouvée de ce qu'il pensait être de la peinture en aérosol, a pris vie sous la forme d'un super-chien ultra-intelligent fait de nanobots.

programme.title: Ghoster : le fantôme aux miroirs
programme.desc: Une jeune fille et son père doivent percer les secrets du manoir d'Echoville qui retient captif l'esprit le plus mignon du monde, Ghoster, depuis 50 ans, avant que le dragon fantôme ne les anéantisse tous dans sa quête d'immortalité.

programme.title: Les Lunnis et leurs Aventures Magiques
programme.desc: Marie est une jeune fille pleine d'imagination grâce aux contes racontés par son grand-père. Un jour, le méchant Crude découvre le moyen d'en finir avec le Livre magique qui contient toutes les histoires inventées par l'Humanité et son gardien Lucrecia.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: Seconde Guerre Mondiale. Le capitaine américain Jack Wosick, récemment tombé en disgrâce, se voit offrir un moyen de se racheter lorsqu'on lui propose de commander une unité de marginaux sans aucune discipline, les « War Pigs ».

programme.title: Le Commando
programme.desc: Un agent de la DEA doit protéger sa famille contre un criminel, récemment libéré, et ses hommes à la recherche d'une cachette où des millions de dollars seraient dissimulés : au sein même de la maison de l'agent...

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une championne de course en puissance qui voit sa vie basculer lorsque son père décède. Mineure, elle ne peut compter que sur son frère qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis dix ans et qui est toxicomane. Ensemble, ils vont essayer de remonter la pente grâce à leur passion commune : la course automobile.

programme.title: Andron
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille dans le labyrinthe noir d'Andron. Ils ne se souviennent plus qui ils sont et comment ils se sont retrouvés là. Ils doivent alors déchiffrer des codes, comprendre des signaux et vaincre les défis de cet endroit.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood ne veut pas mourir
programme.desc: Dans une demeure isolée, Susan Aylwood, ancienne star du cinéma, vit avec sa gouvernante la discrète Caroline. Entourée de ses souvenirs de gloire, elle mène son entourage à la baguette. Mais quelle terrible vérité se cache derrière les apparences ?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia est entraînée dans un appartement pour une fête. Face à la foule de visages, elle est sans repères, comme perdue dans un paysage de montagne recouvert de nuages.

programme.title: Garage rouge
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon n'ose plus sortir de chez lui après une agression.

programme.title: A perdre haleine
programme.desc: Emile, jeune violoncelliste, est submergé par l'angoisse le jour d'un concert...

programme.title: Léon d'Oural
programme.desc: Au cours d'une prestigieuse course, des chevaux, poussés par les jockeys, enchaînent avec vigueur les obstacles.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Papa dans maman
programme.desc: Milieu de la nuit. Des gémissements se font entendre derrière la porte des parents. Deux jeunes soeurs s'interrogent...

programme.title: Le quepa sur la vilni !
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, André sort de sa paisible retraite . Sur ordre du maire, il doit mener à travers monts une troupe d'hommes-sandwichs à vélo pour attirer les spectateurs à l'inauguration du cinéma local.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: John, un jeune bodybuilder, se prépare jour après jour pour une compétition, les NPC Georgia Bodybulding Championships. Sa vie est un rituel, une mécanique parfaitement réglée. Concentré sur son objectif, il ne lâche rien, espérant atteindre sur scène cet instant de bonheur unique : le flow.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: C'est la première nuit d'Ed et Sarah dans leur nouvelle maison : une ferme isolée à la frontière de l'Ecosse. Alors qu'ils pensaient échapper au stress de leur vie londonienne le sommeil de Sarah est troublé par des bruits suspects. Leur nouvelle vie se transforme en cauchemar lorsque le couple part faire des investigations dans les bois à la nuit tombée. Ils réalisent alors qu'ils ne sont pas ici chez eux et encore moins les bienvenus.

programme.title: Shred
programme.desc: Max et Eddy sont d'anciens snowboardeurs professionnels des années 90 qui ont ruiné leur carrière à cause de leur comportement imprudent. Travaillant désormais comme opérateurs de remontées mécaniques à Stubby Peaks, ils décident de créer un camp/équipe de snowboard pour revenir sur le devant de la scène. Kingsley Brown, leur ancien rival et président de l'Association Nationale de Snowboard, fait tout pour discréditer leur camp et empêcher ces fous dangereux de revenir dans le sport. Max et Eddy doivent alors partir à la recherche de nouveaux talents prometteurs pour rejoindre leur équipe et participer à la prochaine compétition de snowboard.

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Le lit conjugal
programme.desc: À quarante ans, Alfonso épouse la pieuse Régina. Mais son désir insatiable épuise rapidement Alfonso. Lorsqu'elle tombe enceinte, il est mis à l'écart, contraint de vivre loin d'elle et de ne plus la déranger.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: En 1947, Dalton Trumbo était le meilleur scénariste d'Hollywood, jusqu'à ce que lui-même et d'autres artistes soient emprisonnés et mis sur liste noire pour leurs convictions politiques.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronaute Roy McBride s'aventure jusqu'aux confins du système solaire à la recherche de son père disparu et pour résoudre un mystère qui menace la survie de notre planète.

programme.title: Stratton
programme.desc: Stratton, agent du MI6, s'infiltre avec son coéquipier Marty dans un laboratoire iranien pour intercepter le vol de molécules chimiques mortelles. Mais à leur arrivée, celles-ci ont déjà disparu et la mission tourne mal…

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: À la mort de sa mère, Maya retrouve son père à New York. Celui-ci l'emmène au Caire, où il est alors enlevé.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Afin de protéger une belle femme et son fils d'un braqueur, l'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) est chargé d'une opération secrète consistant à se déguiser en femme âgée obèse afin d'enquêter sur un crime antérieur.

programme.title: Leprechaun 4: Destination Cosmos
programme.desc: Sur une planète d'une galaxie lointaine, un lutin assoiffé de pouvoir (Guerrewick Davis), kidnappe une belle princesse étrangère (Rebekah Carlton) afin de l'épouser pour son titre royal et son or et de gouverner l'univers. Tandis qu'il échafaude ses plans démentiels, il ne tient pas compte d'un peloton de marines venus de la Terre pour sauver la princesse et déjouer ses plans. Criminel accompli, le lutin s'introduit sur le vaisseau spatial en orbite et fait de gros dégâts parmi l'équipage pour tenter de reconquérir sa promise.

programme.title: 200,000 dollars en cavale
programme.desc: Une réinterprétation palpitante de ce qui aurait pu arriver après que le célèbre preneur d'otages D. B. Cooper s'échappe avec 200 000 dollars en sautant en parachute d'un jet. Avec Treat Williams et Robert Duvall.

programme.title: The Last Shoot Out
programme.desc: Dans ce western grinçant avec Bruce Dern (Les Huit Salopards), un brave homme armé sauve une jeune mariée en fuite, mais doit faire face à la violente colère de la famille du marié, furieuse et assoiffée de vengeance.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Un nouveau venu au lycée (Sean Faris) apprend les arts de combat auprès d'un mentor avisé (Djimon Hounsou) et prouve son talent lors de compétitions d'arts martiaux mixtes clandestins

programme.title: Déchaînés
programme.desc: Purgeant une peine de longue durée, Gary Tison est enfermé dans une prison isolée en Arizona. Il parvient à s'enfuire un après-midi de l'été 1978. Espérant trouver son salut au Mexique, il ignore qu'il est pourchassé par Cooper, shérif à la retraite.

programme.title: Bye Bye Love
programme.desc: New York, 1963. Une chroniqueuse, dont le nouveau roman qui rejette l'amour est couronné de succès, tombe sous le charme d'un journaliste tombeur de ces dames qui décide de la séduire…

programme.title: Contre-enquête
programme.desc: Un policier enquête pour déterminer si l'homme condamné pour le meurtre de sa fille est réellement coupable.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: L'agent littéraire Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy), un beau parleur, veut collaborer avec un gourou new age, le Dr Sinja. Mais quand un mystérieux arbre apparaît dans son jardin, Jack doit impérativement changer avant que sa dernière feuille ne tombe.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.11

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Alone together
programme.desc: June, critique gastronomique, se rend dans le nord de l'État de New York pour une courte escapade romantique afin d'échapper à la pandémie qui sévit en ville.

programme.title: Sexy movie
programme.desc: Romantique absolue, Julia Jones a toujours cru au Grand Amour. Lorsqu'elle rencontre enfin l'Homme De Sa Vie, le très british Grant Funkyerdoder, elle croit tenir le bon bout. Mais c'est sans compter sur le retour d' Andy, l'ex de Grant, une vraie bombe sexuelle...

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Nick Marshall est LE macho à l'américaine! La clope au bec, toujours bien rasé, les abdos hyper dessinés, ce qu'il faut de poils, un regard à tomber par terre, et bien sûr le sourire éclatant laissant entrevoir ses dents d'une blancheur étincelante.

programme.title: Coup de foudre à Mumbai
programme.desc: Après le crash de son avion, Sarah a été recueillie par les habitants d'un village près de Mumbai. La jeune femme devient le guide de Max, un routier engagé par Oskar, dont elle a pour mission de le conduire à son village. Mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Sarah découvre qu'Oskar veut chasser les villageois pour monter un projet en vue des Jeux Olympiques. Max, qui est tombé amoureux de la jeune femme, décide de se joindre à sa cause.

programme.title: Taj mahal
programme.desc: À 18 ans, Louise loge avec sa famille dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace. Un soir, restée seule dans sa chambre, elle entend des bruits étranges dans les couloirs de l'hôtel. Elle comprend au bout de quelques minutes qu'il s'agit d'une attaque terroriste.

programme.title: Hyena Road
programme.desc: Les forces armées canadiennes sont chargées de sécuriser un territoire taliban dans la province de Kandahar, dans le sud de l'Afghanistan.

programme.title: L'énigme
programme.desc: L'étudiante Holly Teller (Elisabeth Harnois) est attirée par la mystérieuse petite ville de Riddle, en Pennsylvanie, à la recherche de son frère disparu. Contre la volonté du shérif local (Val Kilmer) et d'un ancien du village (William Sadler), elle commence à percer un mystère lié à un hôpital psychiatrique abandonné à la périphérie de la ville, découvrant un passé terrifiant que les habitants sont déterminés à garder secret.

programme.title: Diablo the Ultimate Race
programme.desc: Kuba essaie de gagner rapidement de l'argent pour aider sa petite sœur très malade.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Executive Protection
programme.desc: Max Webber, ancien des forces spéciales, a consacré sa vie et sa carrière à la protection des autres.

programme.title: Nom de Code: Geronimo

programme.title: Ma Mère Et Moi
programme.desc: Récemment veuve, Marnie Minervini n'en demeure pas moins une éternelle optimiste. Elle déménage à Hollywood pour se rapprocher de sa fille, et peu à peu, se fait à l'idée de sortir à nouveau avec des hommes.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: L'histoire de Matilda, jeune prodige, flanquée de parents abrutis et d'une directrice d'école terroriste, qui s'épanouira grâce à son institutrice.

Bob avait promis d'emmener tout le monde à Hawaii, mais il a brusquement décidé qu'un long périple en camping-car serait bien plus excitant... Jamie et les enfants ne passent pas vraiment les vacances qu'ils espéraient.

programme.title: L'Étoile

Un jour, il trouve le courage de se libérer et rejoint Ruth, l'adorable brebis, et Dave, la colombe hilarante aux hautes aspirations. Accompagnés par trois chameaux déjantés et des animaux excentriques de la ferme, Bo et ses nouveaux amis suivent l'Étoile pour vivre l'aventure de leurs rêves - Remplie de rires - et ils participent à la plus belle histoire jamais contée : celle du premier Noël.

programme.title: Mon beauf, ma sœur et moi

programme.title: L'Arnaqueuse
programme.desc: Peg Dahl est une jeune femme qui espère quitter sa ville natale de Buffalo. Elle se lance dans le business du recouvrement de dettes. La guerre est déclarée avec le Roi des chasseurs de dettes de Buffalo.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose
programme.desc: Un célèbre entraîneur de football est assassiné et sa bague, ornée du fameux diamant ‘'La Panthère Rose'' a disparu. L'inspecteur en chef Dreyfuss confie l'enquête à l'inspecteur Jacques Clouseau, le plus maladroit, le plus empoté, le plus incapable des agents de police.

programme.title: Fort invincible

programme.title: La vengeance de Ringo
programme.desc: Deux aventuriers sauvent la vie d'un homme qui a une carte au trésor tatouée dans le dos.

programme.desc: Un jeune homme retourne dans sa ville natale dix ans après avoir tué le meurtrier de ses parents. Une fois sur place, il est chargé d'aider le shérif.

Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

Le sculpteur Démétrius, chargé de réaliser le visage de la déesse Diane, tombe amoureux d'une esclave, la chrétienne Lerna. Avec l'arrivée de la peste, le mécontentement du peuple grandit et Antigonus accuse facilement les chrétiens, qui sont immédiatement arrêtés et condamnés à mort. Les troupes romaines arrivent pour rétablir l'ordre, sauvant les deux amants Démétrius et Lerna.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. Alex is promoting his annual Comedy Football Trophy match taking place at Chesham United, featuring some of the biggest names in comedy playing for a great cause.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. If they get a second question wrong they have to kneel. And if they get a third question wrong, they are eliminated. 10 contestants compete for one cash prize.

From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E8

Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E9

Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw – animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight. Winning these battles will make the difference between life and death, and with the stakes so high don't be surprised if the biggest animals don't have everything their own way. Welcome to nature's fight club.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for! From lion scraps to insect warfare, these conflicts can provide us with the most remarkable spectacles in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales
programme.desc: North Atlantic right whales are dying faster than they can reproduce. With less than 400 remaining, these great whales rarely die of natural causes. Instead they are run over by ships or suffer lethal injuries from fishing gear. If we don't stop killing them, in 20 years they could be extinct. From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: Acts of Vengeance

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up from her unconscious state and is shocked to find that she is in the Raj Mahal. Gayatri is frightened thinking as to who could have brought her here. Soon, she sees a paper that has something written on it. Just when she is about to read it out, a flapping window draws her attention. Her eye catches the photographs of Indravadhan and Sulakshana. Soon, she hears the sound of Indravadhan's shoes coming towards the room. Will Gayatri be caught by Indravadhan? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri gets her hands decorated with mehandi and she thinks about her future with Indravadhan. Indravadhan, on the other hand, talks to Sulakshana's photographs claiming that soon he would get married to another girl. Indravadhan engraves the letter 'S' on his chest so as to express his deep love for his late wife, Sulakshana. Later, Badi Raani maa and Raj Mata visit Govind Seth's home. Badi Raani maa tells him that she needs to discuss with him about the wedding proposal. What will Badi Raani maa say to Govind Seth? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Badi Raani Maa and Raj Mata are at Govind Seth's home. Raj Mata tells Badi Raani Maa that Govind Seth and she have made a deal. Gayatri, who is listening to their conversation from the balcony, is asked not eavesdrop on the elders' conversation. Gayatri then leaves the place and is unable to acknowledge the truth. Govind Seth explains to Badi Raani Maa that the deal that he and Raj Mata have made. Hearing this, Badi Raani Maa is flabbergasted. Will Badi Raani Maa stop Indravadhan and Gayatri's wedding? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kuwar and Kokila work their plan out to hurt Indravadhan emotionally. Kuwar, on the other hand, uses the help of his men to get an explosive coconut into the wedding so as to kill Indravadhan. Badi Raani Maa, on the other hand, finds the guard carrying the explosive coconut and she asks him to give the coconut to her. Later, Indravadhan and Gayatri are all set to reach the mandap but he gets angry on seeing it. Why is Indravadhan angry on seeing the mandap? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of love, revenge and royalty. Set in 1940s, this period drama tells the story of Gayatri and Rana Indravadan, and their following generations with ever changing backdrops. It has love, tragedy, revenge and also a touch of supernatural plotline.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Just when Raj Mata puts the coconut into Gayatri's lap, it accidentally falls down and breaks, revealing a bomb inside. Everybody is shocked to find the bomb and Raj Mata asks Indravadhan to stay away from the bomb. Indravadhan quickly picks up the bomb and just when he is about leave the place to throw the bomb, Gayatri holds his hand. Indravadhan asks Gaytri to leave his hand but the latter claims that her life has now joined his and she would not leave his hand under any circumstance. Indravadhan and Gayatri rush to throw the bomb and shortly after they leave, the guests hear the blast. Kuwar and Kokila grin away hearing the blast sound. Are Indravadhan and Gayatri alright? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The wedding of Indravadhan and Gayatri commences successfully but Kokila does not miss a single chance to hurt Indravadhan. She gifts Gayatri some jewelry that once upon a time was gifted to Sulakshana. When Indravadhan picks up the sindhoor to apply it to Gayatri's forehead, he notices the jewelry and remembers his late wife, Sulakshana. Indravadhan remains silent and continues with the rituals. On the other hand, Kuwar, Kokila and their son talk about their loss as they were unable to carry out any of their plans. Just then, Kokila says she would make Gayatri's life miserable. What plan has Kokila in mind? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22
programme.desc: When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.23
programme.desc: Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.24
programme.desc: After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.25
programme.desc: Leaving her audience with Inbin, Jeongi runs into Gangcheon and Yukdo at the palace. When King Seonjo refers to Euldam as a traitor, Jeongi is left on edge. Together with Taedo, she devises a plan to ensnare Gangcheon. Later, Gwanghae returns the bowl Jeongi once gave to Son Haengsu. Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.
